title: Fundamental Follower Needs Inventory (work version)
instructions: The following statements are about the leaders in your workplace. Indicate how much you agree with each one.
citation: Sheng, X., Andrews, W., & van Vugt, M. (2026). The psychology of following: Conceptualizing and validating the Fundamental Follower Needs Inventory. Journal of Applied Psychology, 111(6), 768-801. https://doi.org/10.1037/apl0001347
license: The Fundamental Follower Needs Inventory (c) 2026 by Xiaotian Sheng, Wendy Andrews & Mark van Vugt is licensed under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Items are reproduced verbatim from Table 4 of the article. NoDerivatives: do not reword, abridge, or translate these items.
note: Full 22-item administration, work-domain instructions ("the leaders in your workplace"). Item wording checked against the article's own item table (p.779) on 2026-09-02: five items differed only in contractions and one in toward/towards, now corrected to match verbatim.

protection: I wish to have a leader who positions themselves between my group and an outside threat.
I am motivated to follow a leader who stands up for me against outsiders.
Having a leader who takes care of my security is valuable to me.
It is important for me to have a leader who protects the group from any harm.
affiliation: I wish to have a leader who creates a good group atmosphere.
I am motivated to follow a leader who creates a sense of camaraderie.
Having a leader who can bring the group together is valuable to me.
It is important for me to have a leader who makes me feel part of the group.
status: I need a leader who improves my standing.
I wish to have a leader who helps our group achieve status.
I am motivated to follow a leader who helps me become wealthy.
Having a leader who helps me achieve prominence is valuable to me.
vision: I wish to have a leader who sets clear goals.
I am motivated to follow a leader who has a clear vision.
Having a leader who moves the group toward a shared direction is valuable to me.
expertise: I need a leader who enables me to learn from them.
Having a leader who is a good teacher is valuable to me.
It is important for me to have a leader who offers advice.
fairness: I need a leader who ensures that procedures are free of bias.
I wish to have a leader who carefully listens to both parties when mediating a conflict.
Having a leader who makes fair and balanced decisions is valuable to me.
It is important for me to have a leader who manages within-group conflicts in a just way.
